name: agent-orchestrator
description: Pilot-only local daemon scaffolding for the Agent Orchestrator v1.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --input-type=module --eval 'import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process"; const tests = new Map([["config", "dist/test/config.test.js"], ["codex-lifecycle", "dist/test/codex/codex-lifecycle.test.js"], ["manifest", "dist/test/manifest/loader.test.js"]]); const selector = process.argv[1]; const testFile = tests.get(selector); if (testFile === undefined) { console.error(`Unknown test selector: ${selector ?? "(missing)"}`); process.exit(1); } const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--test", testFile], { stdio: "inherit" }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);'
